description: What a node is called: the name its canvas header shows, which also titles its computed dataset. Read by src/tests/utils/nodeDisplayLabelCases.test.ts (nodeDisplayLabel) and by backend/tests/test_execution/test_node_names.py (execution/node_names.py display_label). customLabel is the node's renamed header (packageTemplateLabel); templateLabel is its template's label from the package manifest, absent when no installed template matches the type.

cases.name: a built-in node takes its template's label
cases.label: Python Computation

cases.name: an unversioned type takes the same label
cases.label: Python Computation

cases.name: a renamed header wins over the template's label
cases.label: Dict output

cases.name: a blank renamed header is ignored
cases.label: Data Loading

cases.name: no template: the type in words, without its version
cases.label: Data Loading

cases.name: no template: a package type in words, without its version
cases.label: Uhvi Zonal Stats

cases.label: Autk Grammar
